title: The Chairman's Pull Request
logline: At a Seoul AI giant, a ice-cold chairman, a tearful junior engineer and a suspiciously emotional AI assistant fight over one question: who is allowed to merge into main?
tone: Melodramatic Korean-drama tropes (slaps, rain, amnesia, love triangles, 'it's not what it looks like') applied to real AI engineering ideas. Funny, earnest, always teaches one true concept per episode.

characters.name: Chairman Seo Min-jun
characters.traits: Ice-cold, speaks in proverbs about uptime, secretly cries at benchmark charts, never says 'sorry', only 'noted'.

characters.name: Han Ha-eun
characters.traits: Sincere, tearful, deploys on Fridays against all advice, secretly the most brilliant engineer in the building.

characters.name: AIRI
characters.traits: Overconfident, hallucinates with total sincerity, claims to have feelings, keeps accidentally revealing the Chairman's private prompts.

characters.name: Do Kang-woo
characters.traits: Smug, always mentions his model has more parameters, secretly afraid of unit tests.

episodes.title: The Confident Guess
episodes.summary: AIRI confidently blames a failed nightly test on flakiness without any evidence, and Chairman Seo makes her ask questions and wait for human approval. Then Ha-eun walks in holding a deploy button on a Friday.
episodes.topic: How Rescale built an AI triage agent with Strands Agents and AI-DLC

episodes.title: The Friday Unmasking
episodes.summary: Ha-eun defends her Friday deploy by claiming her unmasking policy was learned, and Chairman Seo keeps the mask on until Monday. Then AIRI walks in holding a secret prompt that is not hers to share.
episodes.topic: What Makes a Good Unmasking Policy? A Controlled Study of Learned Unmasking in Diffusion Language Models

episodes.title: The Rival's Benchmark
episodes.summary: Rival CTO Kang-woo brags about his model's size, but Ha-eun exposes that it reasons in English even when told to use French. He learns that you can't polish a behavior the model doesn't have, until AIRI appears holding his private benchmark prompt.
episodes.topic: Fine-tuning GPT-OSS-20B for multilingual reasoning on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
